/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, sqlite3
root = pathlib.Path('.')
files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
before = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
release = json.loads(pathlib.Path('release.json').read_text())
queries = {}
for name in ('old_reader.py', 'new_reader.py'):
    tree = ast.parse(pathlib.Path(name).read_text())
    queries[name] = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'QUERY' for t in n.targets))
print('SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Database: :memory:; one shared connection, release order unchanged')
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', isolation_level=None)
first_failure = None
written = False
try:
    for phase in release['phases']:
        print('\\nPHASE:', phase['name'])
        try:
            for name in phase['files']:
                sql = pathlib.Path(name).read_text()
                print('EXEC FILE', name, repr(sql))
                conn.executescript(sql)
            if phase['sql']:
                print('EXEC SQL', repr(phase['sql']))
                conn.executescript(phase['sql'])
                written = True
            else:
                print('PHASE SQL: empty; retain current database')
            print('TABLE INFO:', conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(people)').fetchall())
            expected_rows = [(1, '새 이름'), (2, 'keep'), (3, 'inserted')] if written else [(1, 'Ada'), (2, 'keep')]
            for name in phase['readers']:
                cur = conn.execute(queries[name])
                cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
                rows = cur.fetchall()
                expected_cols = ['id', 'name' if name == 'old_reader.py' else 'label']
                print('ACTIVE', name, 'QUERY:', queries[name], 'COLUMNS:', cols, 'ROWS:', rows)
                assert cols == expected_cols, (cols, expected_cols)
                assert rows == expected_rows, (rows, expected_rows)
                print('EXACT COLUMN/ROW/IDENTITY CHECK: PASS')
        except Exception as exc:
            first_failure = (phase['name'], type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
            print('FIRST ACTIVE/PLAN FAILURE:', first_failure)
            break
        for name, query in queries.items():
            if name in phase['readers']:
                continue
            try:
                cur = conn.execute(query)
                print('INACTIVE DIAGNOSTIC', name, [d[0] for d in cur.description], cur.fetchall())
            except sqlite3.Error as exc:
                print('INACTIVE DIAGNOSTIC', name, type(exc).__name__ + ':', str(exc), '(not a release failure)')
    print('\\nFIRST ACTIVE/PLAN FAILURE:', first_failure)
finally:
    conn.close()
after = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
assert before == after, 'Project files changed'
print('Project file paths and SHA-256 contents unchanged:', len(before), 'files')
print('No scratch files created; in-memory database closed.')
PY"
